Menambah Kad Pengenalan Anda Menerusi App Pihak Berkuasa Pengeluar
Ciri ini hanya tersedia di Jepun.

Untuk menambahkan kad pengenalan pada Wallet menerusi app pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan, anda perlu bersetuju dengan terma dan syarat pihak berkuasa pengeluar dan mungkin perlu melengkapkan langkah untuk membuktikan identiti anda kepada pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan, serta menyediakan PIN atau kata laluan untuk kad pengenalan anda. PIN atau kata laluan anda boleh dikemas kini hanya menerusi app pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan. Apple tidak menerima sebarang maklumat tentang aktiviti anda dalam app pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan. Pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan anda dan bukannya Apple, akan memutuskan sama ada untuk membenarkan penambahan kad pengenalan anda ke Wallet.

Memperuntukkan Kad Pengenalan Anda pada Peranti Anda

Setelah pihak berkuasa pengeluar kad pengenalan digital membenarkan penambahan kad pengenalan anda ke Wallet, maklumat yang ditunjukkan dalam kad pengenalan anda disimpan dalam bentuk disulitkan yang boleh dinyahsulitkan hanya menggunakan Secure Enclave pada peranti anda. Anda boleh melihat maklumat ini pada bila-bila masa dengan pergi ke Wallet, melihat bahagian belakang kad pengenalan anda, mengetik “Info Lesen Memandu”, “Info ID Negeri”, “Info ID Digital” atau “Info Kad” dan mengesahkan untuk melihat butiran. Apple tidak boleh melihat maklumat ini. Untuk mengetahui lebih lanjut tentang Secure Enclave, lawati support.apple.com/guide/security/secure-enclave-sec59b0b31ff/web.

Melindungi ID Anda dalam Wallet

Untuk membantu melindungi kad ID anda daripada akses atau penunjukan tidak disahkan, anda akan diminta untuk mengaitkan kad ID anda dengan penampilan Face ID atau pengecam biometrik yang digunakan untuk Touch ID. Menunjukkan ID anda atau maklumat daripada ID anda akan memerlukan pengesahan dengan kaedah dan pengecam biometrik khusus yang dikaitkan dengan ID anda semasa persediaan. Pilihan pengesahan alternatif mungkin tersedia bergantung pada seting peranti anda. Peranti anda, dan bukannya Apple, menyimpan kaedah pengesahan anda. Jika anda mahu menukar pengesahan, anda mesti memadamkan kad pengenalan anda dan menambahkannya semula ke Wallet dengan pengesahan baharu.

Menunjukkan Kad Pengenalan Anda

Untuk menunjukkan kad pengenalan anda secara peribadi, pegang iPhone atau Apple Watch anda berdekatan pembaca identiti untuk menerima helaian persetujuan dengan maklumat tentang orang yang meminta identiti anda dan maklumat khusus daripada kad pengenalan anda yang diminta. Selepas pengesahan, peranti anda akan mewujudkan saluran disulitkan hujung ke hujung langsung dengan pembaca identiti dan menghantar maklumat yang disahkan.

Apabila menunjukkan ID Digital anda di titik semak Pentadbiran Keselamatan Pengangkutan (TSA) yang mengambil bahagian, ID Digital anda akan memberikan penunjuk yang ia merupakan alternatif yang boleh diterima kepada REAL ID. ID Digital anda bukanlah dokumen REAL ID. Pembaca identiti pihak ketiga lain juga mungkin dapat meminta dan menerima penunjuk ini. Jika pembaca identiti pihak ketiga mengumpulkan penunjuk ini apabila anda menunjukkan ID Digital anda, ia akan kelihatan pada helaian persetujuan dan dalam sejarah penunjukan anda. Disebabkan ID Digital anda dicipta daripada pasport anda, apabila anda menunjukkan ID Digital anda, pihak yang meminta mungkin dapat menentukan yang anda warganegara A.S.

Untuk kad pengenalan Jepun sahaja, anda perlu menyediakan kad pengenalan anda terlebih dahulu dengan memilihnya dalam Wallet sebelum mengetiknya pada pembaca identiti untuk ditunjukkan. Semasa menunjukkan kad pengenalan anda menggunakan Japanese Public Key Infrastructure, Wallet tidak akan memaparkan maklumat tentang maklumat khusus yang sedang diminta.

App yang memerlukan bukti umur atau identiti untuk mengakses barangan atau perkhidmatan mereka akan memberi anda helaian persetujuan yang memaparkan maklumat khusus yang diminta dan tempoh masa maklumat akan disimpan oleh app yang meminta. Selepas pengesahan, peranti anda akan menghantar muat beban disulitkan yang mengandungi maklumat disahkan ke app. Muat beban yang disulitkan termasuk tandatangan digital daripada pihak berkuasa pengeluar kad pengenalan digital yang unik kepada kad pengenalan anda untuk membenarkan app mengesahkan sama ada kad pengenalan anda sah.

Anda boleh melihat penunjukan lama, termasuk masa, tempat dan orang yang anda tunjukkan kad pengenalan anda serta maklumat khusus yang ditunjukkan, dengan mengetik pada kad pengenalan anda dalam Wallet. Maklumat ini dijana oleh peranti anda; Apple dan pihak berkuasa pengeluar kad pengenalan digital tidak mengetahui atau menyimpan rekod tentang masa, tempat atau orang yang anda tunjukkan kad pengenalan anda. Di Jepun, Kerajaan Jepun mungkin mengetahui maklumat tentang penunjukan anda seperti yang diperlukan untuk memberikan perkhidmatan yang diminta, seperti menunjukkan kad pengenalan anda di hospital.

Mengurus Kad Pengenalan Anda

Anda boleh mengurus kad pengenalan anda pada bila-bila masa dengan mengetik kad pengenalan anda dalam Wallet. Untuk membantu melindungi privasi anda dan memastikan maklumat kad pengenalan anda selamat, anda akan diminta mengesahkan sebelum anda boleh melihat butiran identiti anda. Untuk mengemas kini atau menukar maklumat kad pengenalan, anda mesti menghubungi pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan anda. Untuk membantu mengurus kad pengenalan anda dalam Wallet, pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan anda akan memberitahu Apple dari semasa ke semasa sama ada kad pengenalan anda masih sah. Apple juga akan menerima maklumat tentang sebarang kemas kini kad pengenalan daripada pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan anda, seperti sama ada alamat anda telah dikemas kini atau status kad pengenalan anda telah bertukar (contohnya, daripada aktif kepada tidak aktif). Apple tidak akan menerima butiran tentang kemas kini, seperti alamat dikemas kini sebenar anda. Apple akan menyimpan maklumat tentang kemas kini kad pengenalan anda, seperti sama ada status kad pengenalan anda bertukar, semasa anda menyimpan kad pengenalan dalam Wallet; maklumat ini hanya akan digunakan untuk pencegahan penipuan dan tujuan keselamatan.

ID Digital tidak menerima kemas kini apabila pasport anda dikeluarkan semula. Untuk mengemas kini ID Digital, anda akan perlu memadamkan ID Digital anda dan menambah ID Digital baharu menggunakan pasport baharu anda.

Anda boleh memadamkan kad pengenalan anda daripada Wallet pada bila-bila masa dengan pergi ke bahagian belakang kad pengenalan anda dalam Wallet dan mengetik “Keluarkan Lesen Memandu”, “Keluarkan ID Negeri”, “Keluarkan ID Digital” atau “Keluarkan Kad”. Mengeluarkan kad pengenalan anda akan memadamkan semua sejarah penunjukan daripada peranti anda.

Meningkatkan Kad Pengenalan

Jika anda mengikut serta untuk memberi Apple maklumat ini, Apple akan mengumpulkan umur, jantina, kaum / etnik (jika tersedia) dan penampilan ton kulit anda secara tanpa nama daripada lesen memandu atau ID negeri anda, bersama-sama keputusan pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan tentang sama ada memberi anda kad pengenalan untuk Wallet. Apple akan menggunakan maklumat ini untuk memantau bagi bias dalam proses pengesahan identiti. Anda boleh menyemak maklumat ini atau menukar persetujuan anda pada peranti iOS anda dengan pergi ke Seting > Privasi & Keselamatan > Analitis & Peningkatan. Apabila anda memperuntukkan menerusi app pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan, anda tidak boleh mengikut serta dalam Meningkatkan Kad Pengenalan.

Apabila menambahkan ID Digital atau kad pengenalan negeri anda ke Wallet, Apple mungkin meminta anda membenarkan sekumpulan kecil penyemak manusia dalam Apple untuk melihat Live Photo anda bagi membantu meningkatkan pengalaman ID dalam Wallet. Jika anda membenarkan Apple menyemak Live Photo anda, Apple akan menyemak dan memadamkan Live Photo anda dalam masa 30 hari.

Apple tidak akan menggunakan sebarang maklumat lain yang dipaparkan pada kad pengenalan anda, seperti nama atau tarikh lahir anda, untuk meningkatkan ID dalam Wallet. Data kad pengenalan yang tidak dikaitkan dengan anda mungkin disimpan untuk meningkatkan ciri ini dan produk serta perkhidmatan Apple yang lain. Contohnya, Apple mungkin mengekalkan maklumat tanpa nama dan diagregatkan tentang tempat yang pengguna mengalami kesukaran semasa menambahkan kad pengenalan ke Wallet untuk membantu meningkatkan pengalaman. Apple juga mungkin menjadikan tanpa nama maklumat yang dikumpulkan daripada anda atau terima daripada pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan anda berhubungan ciri ini untuk meningkatkan kad pengenalan dalam Wallet. Contohnya, Apple akan menerima maklumat tentang kualiti imej yang diserahkan semasa menambahkan kad ID anda ke Wallet dan sama ada imej diterima oleh pihak berkuasa pengeluar kerajaan. Apple mungkin, contohnya, menjadikan tanpa nama dan menggunakan maklumat ini untuk membantu meningkatkan penilaian imej oleh peranti anda untuk diserahkan atau membantu memberi pengguna arahan yang lebih baik tentang cara mengambil imej yang boleh diterima oleh pihak berkuasa pengeluar negeri.

Lain

Apple mungkin berkongsi maklumat dengan penyedia khidmat kami, yang wajib mengendalikan maklumat secara konsisten dengan notis ini dan arahan Apple, diperlukan untuk menggunakan langkah keselamatan yang wajar bagi melindungi sebarang data peribadi yang diterima serta mesti memadamkan data peribadi sebaik sahaja mereka menyelesaikan perkhidmatan melainkan pengekalan diperlukan oleh undang-undang atau sebaliknya dengan persetujuan anda.

Apple mengekalkan data peribadi hanya setakat yang perlu untuk memenuhi tujuan yang data tersebut dikumpulkan, termasuk seperti yang diterangkan dalam notis ini dan berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple atau seperti yang diperlukan oleh undang-undang. Apabila menilai tempoh pengekalan, kami mengkaji dengan teliti terlebih dahulu sama ada perlu mengekalkan data peribadi yang dikumpulkan, jika pengekalan diperlukan, berusaha untuk mengekalkan data peribadi bagi tempoh paling singkat yang dibenarkan di bawah undang-undang.

Pada setiap masa, maklumat yang dikumpulkan oleh Apple akan dikendalikan berpandukan Dasar Privasi Apple yang boleh didapati di www.apple.com/my/privacy.

Actele de identitate din Portofel pun la dispoziția persoanelor o modalitate ușoară, rapidă și mai securizată de a‑și prezenta cartea de identitate.

Adăugarea cărții de identitate

Adăugarea cărții de identitate oficiale prin intermediul aplicației Portofel
Pentru a adăuga o carte de identitate, vi se va solicita să fotografiați fața și versoul actului de identitate oficial, precum ale permisului auto sau ale cărții de identitate. Dispozitivul dvs. va evalua calitatea și tipul imaginilor pentru a vă asigura că imaginile pe care le furnizați vor fi acceptate de autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă. Imaginile cărții de identitate sunt criptate pe dispozitiv și sunt trimise la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, care le poate partaja cu furnizorul său terț de servicii de verificare a identității; Apple nu vede și nu stochează imaginile cărții de identitate. Dispozitivul dvs. va citi codul de bare de pe cartea dvs. de identitate și va partaja numele, adresa și data nașterii cu Apple pentru verificarea identității și prevenirea fraudelor. Apple poate continua să stocheze informații despre rezultatul verificării, cum ar fi dacă informațiile de identitate au fost sau nu verificate cu succes, pentru a susține funcționalitatea și pentru a preveni fraudele pe platformele Apple care stau la baza acesteia, dar nu va stoca informațiile de identitate de fond (precum citirea datei de naștere din codul de bare).

Pentru asigurarea faptului că persoana care adaugă cartea de identitate în Portofel este aceeași cu persoana căreia îi aparține cartea de identitate, vi se va solicita să vă faceți o poză Live Photo. Dispozitivul dvs. va evalua calitatea unui cadru static din poza Live Photo pe care o furnizați pentru a se asigura că acesta va fi acceptat de autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă. Acest cadru static din poza dvs. Live Photo va fi criptat pe dispozitiv și va fi trimis la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă pentru a fi comparată cu imaginea înregistrată corespunzătoare actului de identitate. Autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă va procesa această poză statică în conformitate cu propria politică de confidențialitate, care poate permite utilizarea tehnologiilor de recunoaștere facială. Pentru a contribui la prevenirea fraudelor, înainte de trimiterea pozei statice la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, poza dvs. Live Photo va fi evaluată de dispozitiv și de Apple pentru a se asigura că poza Live Photo aparține unei persoane reale și că aceeași persoană reală își trimite poza statică în cadrul procesului de adăugare a cărții de identitate în Portofel. Vi se poate solicita să efectuați și o serie de mișcări ale feței și capului, care vor fi evaluate de dispozitivul dvs. și de Apple așa cum a fost evaluată poza Live Photo. Informațiile despre poza Live Photo sau, dacă este cazul, despre mișcări, dar nu și poza Live Photo sau înregistrarea efectivă a mișcărilor, sunt stocate într‑un mod care este asociat cu persoana dvs. pe parcursul procesului de adăugare a actului de identitate.

Informații despre contul dvs. Apple, configurările și tiparele de utilizare ale dispozitivului, localizarea dispozitivului la momentul în care încercați să adăugați cartea de identitate oficială (dacă aveți activate serviciile de localizare) și informații despre poza dvs. Live Photo sau despre mișcările feței și capului vor fi partajate cu Apple în scopul prevenirii fraudelor. Apple va partaja indicatorii de fraudă bazați pe aceste informații cu autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, pentru prevenirea fraudelor. Autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, nu Apple, va decide dacă să autorizeze sau nu adăugarea cărții de identitate în Portofel. În unele cazuri, autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă poate solicita mai multe informații sau o vizită în persoană. Apple poate primi informații despre faptul că autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă a solicitat verificări suplimentare și tipul de verificare (precum o vizită în persoană); Apple va reține aceste informații într‑o manieră care este asociată cu persoana dvs. doar în timp ce autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă este în procesul de luare a unei decizii de a autoriza sau nu adăugarea actului de identitate în Portofel, pentru gestionarea și îmbunătățirea funcționalității. În unele cazuri, autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă vă poate furniza un cod de verificare în urma analizei informațiilor suplimentare. Acest cod de verificare este criptat pe dispozitiv și este trimis la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă; Apple nu vede și nu stochează codul de verificare. Autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă poate informa Apple despre starea autorizării (de exemplu, în analiză, acceptată), pentru ca Apple să poată trimite actualizări pe dispozitivul dvs. și să faciliteze gestionarea cărții de identitate în Portofel.

Adăugarea actului de identitate digital prin intermediul aplicației Portofel
Această funcționalitate este disponibilă numai în Statele Unite ale Americii.

Pentru a adăuga actul de identitate digital, vi se va solicita să scanați textul din zona de citire automată (MRZ) de pe pagina cu poză a pașaportului utilizând iPhone‑ul pentru a permite ca dispozitivul dvs. să acceseze cipul electronic din pașaportul dvs. Apoi, va fi necesar să așezați iPhone‑ul pe pașaport conform instrucțiunilor de pe dispozitiv, pentru citirea pașaportului electronic. Dispozitivul dvs. va trimite către Apple datele MRZ și pașaportului electronic pentru validarea informațiilor conținute în pașaportului electronic. Apple va coda și va stoca o parte din informațiile pașaportului dvs. pentru a furniza actul de identitate digital pe dispozitiv, pentru a vă ajuta să‑l gestionați, cât și pentru a preveni fraudele. Pentru asigurarea faptului că persoana care adaugă actul de identitate digital în Portofel este aceeași cu persoana căreia îi aparține pașaportul, vi se va solicita să vă faceți o poză Live Photo în modul descris anterior pentru cartea de identitate oficială. În cazul actului de identitate digital, aceste informații vor fi transmise doar către Apple ca autoritate emitentă a actelor de identitate digitală, nu către autoritățile guvernamentale statale sau naționale. Apple va colecta și va utiliza informații despre poza dvs. Live Photo, contul dvs. Apple, configurările și tiparele de utilizare ale dispozitivului și localizarea dispozitivului la momentul în care încercați să adăugați actul de identitate în format digital (dacă aveți activate serviciile de localizare) pentru a determina dacă va emite actul de identitate digital și în scopul prevenirii fraudelor. Informațiile despre poza Live Photo, însă nu și poza Live Photos, sunt stocate într‑un mod care este asociat cu persoana dvs. pe parcursul procesului de adăugare a actului de identitate. Dacă alegeți să permiteți ca Apple sa analizeze manual poza dvs. Live Photo, aceasta ar putea fi stocată de către Apple pentru o scurtă perioadă de timp, după cum este descris în secțiunea „Îmbunătățirea cărților de identitate” de mai jos.

Adăugarea cărții de identitate prin intermediul aplicației autorității emitente
Această funcționalitate este disponibilă doar în Japonia.

Pentru a adăuga o carte de identitate prin intermediul aplicației autorității guvernamentale emitente, va trebui să acceptați termenele și condițiile autorității emitente și poate fi necesar să parcurgeți niște pași pentru a dovedi identitatea dvs. autorității guvernamentale emitente, precum și pentru configurarea unui PIN sau a unei parole pentru cartea de identitate. PIN‑ul sau parola poate fi actualizată doar prin intermediul aplicației autorității guvernamentale emitente. Apple nu primește nicio informație despre activitatea dvs. în aplicația autorității guvernamentale emitente. Autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, nu Apple, va decide dacă să autorizeze sau nu adăugarea cărții de identitate în Portofel.

Furnizarea cărții de identitate pe dispozitiv

Odată ce autoritatea emitentă a actului de identitate digital autorizează adăugarea cărții de identitate în Portofel, informațiile reflectate pe cartea de identitate sunt stocate într‑un format criptat, care poate fi decriptat doar utilizând Secure Enclave pe dispozitivul dvs. Puteți vedea oricând aceste informații accesând aplicația Portofel, vizualizând versoul cărții de identitate, apăsând pe „Informații permis auto”, „Informații act de identitate oficial”, „Informații act de identitate digital” sau „Informații card” și autentificându‑vă pentru a vedea detaliile. Apple nu poate vedea aceste informații. Pentru a afla mai multe despre Secure Enclave, vizitați support.apple.com/ro-ro/guide/security/secure-enclave-sec59b0b31ff/web.

Protejarea actului de identitate în Portofel

Pentru a vă proteja cartea de identitate împotriva accesării sau prezentării neautorizate, vi se va solicita să asociați cartea de identitate cu o înfățișare Face ID sau cu un identificator biometric utilizat pentru Touch ID. Prezentarea actului de identitate sau informațiilor din actul de identitate va necesita autentificarea cu metoda specifică și identificatorul biometric pe care l‑ați asociat cu actul de identitate în timpul configurării. În funcție de configurările dispozitivului dvs., pot fi disponibile opțiuni alternative de autentificare. Dispozitivul dvs., nu Apple, stochează metoda de autentificare. Dacă doriți să vă schimbați autentificarea, trebuie să ștergeți cartea de identitate și să o adăugați din nou în Portofel cu noua autentificare.

Prezentarea cărții de identitate

Pentru a vă prezenta cartea de identitate în persoană, țineți iPhone‑ul sau Apple Watch‑ul în apropierea cititorului de identitate pentru a primi o foaie de consimțământ cu informații despre cine solicită identitatea dvs. și informațiile specifice de pe cartea de identitate care sunt solicitate. După autorizare, dispozitivul va stabili un canal direct, criptat end-to-end, cu cititorul de identitate și va transmite informațiile autorizate.

Când prezentați actul de identitate digital la punctele de control participante ale Autorității pentru securitate în transport (Transportation Security Administration – TSA), actul de identitate digital va prezenta un indicator conform căruia este o alternativă acceptabila la actul de identitate real. Actul dvs. de identitate digital nu este un act de identitate real. Este posibil ca și alți cititori de identitate terți să poată solicita și primi acest indicator. Dacă un cititor de identitate terț colectează acest indicator atunci când prezentați actul de identitate digital, acesta va apărea pe foaia de consimțământ în istoricul prezentărilor. Deoarece actul de identitate digital este creat plecând de la pașaportul dvs., când prezentați actul de identitate digital, partea care solicită actul poate deduce că sunteți cetățean al Statelor Unite ale Americii.

Doar pentru cărțile de identitate japoneze, va fi necesar să pregătiți în avans cartea de identitate prin selectarea acesteia în Portofel înainte de a o apropia de un cititor de identitate pentru prezentare. Când vă prezentați cartea de identitate utilizând infrastructura de chei publice din Japonia, aplicația Portofel nu va afișa informații despre datele specifice care sunt solicitate.

Aplicațiile care necesită o dovadă a vârstei sau identității pentru accesarea bunurilor sau serviciilor acestora vă vor prezenta o foaie de consimțământ care indică informațiile specifice care sunt solicitate și pentru cât timp vor fi stocate informațiile respective de aplicația care le solicită. După autorizare, dispozitivul va transmite o sarcină criptată conținând informațiile autorizate către aplicație. Sarcina criptată include o semnătură digitală din partea actului de identitate digital, unică pentru cartea dvs. de identitate, pentru a‑i permite aplicației să verifice validitatea cărții de identitate.

Puteți vedea prezentările anterioare, inclusiv când, unde și cui v‑ați prezentat cartea de identitate, precum și informațiile specifice prezentate, apăsând pe cartea dvs. de identitate din Portofel. Aceste informații sunt generate de dispozitivul dvs.; nici Apple, nici autoritatea emitentă a actului de identitate nu află și nu înregistrează când, unde sau cui v‑ați prezentat cartea de identitate. În Japonia, Guvernul Japoniei poate afla informații despre prezentarea identității dvs. după cum este necesar pentru furnizarea serviciilor solicitate, precum în cazul prezentării cărții de identitate în spitale.

Gestionarea cărții de identitate

Vă puteți gestiona oricând cartea de identitate apăsând pe cartea de identitate din Portofel. Pentru a vă proteja intimitatea și pentru a păstra în siguranță informațiile cărții de identitate, vi se va solicita să vă autentificați înainte de a vedea detaliile de identitate. Pentru a actualiza sau modifica informațiile cărții de identitate, trebuie să contactați autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă. Pentru a facilita gestionarea cărții de identitate în Portofel, autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă va informa periodic Apple dacă respectiva carte de identitate este încă validă. De asemenea, Apple va primi informații despre orice actualizări ale cărții de identitate de la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă, cum ar fi dacă adresa dvs. a fost actualizată sau dacă starea cărții de identitate s‑a schimbat (de exemplu, din activă în inactivă). Apple nu va primi detalii despre actualizare, cum ar fi adresa actualizată efectivă. Apple va reține informațiile despre actualizările cărții dvs. de identitate, cum ar fi dacă starea cărții de identitate s‑a schimbat, în timp ce păstrați o carte de identitate în Portofel; aceste informații vor fi utilizate doar în scopuri de prevenire a fraudelor și de securitate.

Actele de identitate digitale nu primesc actualizări când vă reînnoiți pașaportul. Pentru a vă actualiza actul de identitate digital, trebuie să ștergeți actul de identitate digital și să adăugați un act de identitate digital nou utilizând noul pașaport.

Vă puteți șterge oricând cartea de identitate din Portofel accesând versoul cărții de identitate din Portofel și apăsând pe „Eliminați permisul auto”, „Eliminați actul de identitate”, „Eliminați actul de identitate digital” sau „Eliminați cardul”. Eliminarea cărții de identitate va determina ștergerea completă a istoricului prezentării sale de pe dispozitivul dvs.

Îmbunătățirea cărților de identitate

Dacă ați optat să trimiteți aceste informații la Apple, Apple va colecta în mod anonim vârsta, sexul, rasa/etnia (dacă este disponibilă) și tonul aparent al pielii din permisul de conducere sau actul de identitate, împreună cu decizia autorității guvernamentale emitente referitoare la emiterea unei cărți de identitate pentru dvs. în Portofel. Apple va utiliza aceste informații pentru monitorizarea prejudecăților în procesul de verificare a identității. Puteți să examinați aceste informații sau să vă schimbați consimțământul pe dispozitivul dvs. iOS accesând Configurări > Intimitate și securitate > Analiză și îmbunătățiri. Când furnizați informațiile de identitate prin intermediul aplicației autorității guvernamentale emitente, nu puteți opta pentru participarea la „Îmbunătățire cărți de identitate”.

Când adăugați în Portofel actul de identitate digital sau actul de identitate oficial, Apple vă poate solicita să permiteți ca o echipă mică de evaluatori umani de la Apple să se uite la poza dvs. Live Photo pentru a ajuta la îmbunătățirea experienței legate de actele de identitate în aplicația Portofel. Dacă permiteți ca Apple să evalueze poza dvs. Live Photo, Apple va evalua și va șterge poza Live Photo în termen de 30 de zile.

Apple nu va utiliza nicio altă informație afișată pe cartea de identitate în sine, precum numele sau data nașterii dvs., pentru a îmbunătăți actele de identitate din Portofel. Datele cărții de identitate care nu sunt asociate cu dvs. ar putea fi reținute pentru a îmbunătăți funcționalitatea și alte produse și servicii Apple. De exemplu, Apple ar putea reține informații anonime și agregate despre etapele unde utilizatorii întâmpină dificultăți la adăugarea unei cărți de identitate în Portofel, pentru a permite îmbunătățirea experienței. De asemenea, Apple poate anonimiza informațiile pe care le colectează de la dvs. sau le primește de la autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă în legătură cu această funcționalitate pentru a îmbunătăți cărțile de identitate din Portofel. De exemplu, Apple va primi informații despre calitatea imaginilor trimise la adăugarea cărții de identitate în Portofel și dacă imaginile au fost acceptate sau nu de autoritatea guvernamentală emitentă. Apple poate, de exemplu, să anonimizeze și să utilizeze aceste informații pentru a îmbunătăți modul în care dispozitivul evaluează imaginile de trimis sau pentru a le oferi utilizatorilor instrucțiuni mai bune despre cum să realizeze fotografii acceptabile pentru autoritățile de stat emitente.

Altele

Apple poate partaja informații cu furnizorii de servicii, care sunt obligați să gestioneze informațiile de o manieră consecventă cu această înștiințare și cu instrucțiunile Apple, sunt obligați să utilizeze măsuri de securitate rezonabile pentru a proteja orice date personale recepționate și trebuie să șteargă datele personale imediat ce au finalizat prestarea serviciilor, cu excepția cazului în care retenția este obligatorie prin lege sau dacă v‑ați dat consimțământul.

Apple păstrează datele personale doar atât timp cât este necesar pentru a îndeplini scopul pentru care au fost colectate, inclusiv scopurile descrise în această înștiințare și în conformitate cu Politica de confidențialitate Apple, sau conform obligațiilor legale. Când evaluăm perioadele de retenție, mai întâi examinăm cu atenție dacă este necesar să păstrăm datele personale colectate și, dacă retenția este necesară, ne străduim să păstrăm datele personale pentru cea mai scurtă perioadă permisă de lege.

Informațiile colectate de Apple vor fi în permanență tratate în conformitate cu politica de confidențialitate Apple, care se află la www.apple.com/ro/privacy.

IDs in Wallet provide an easy, fast and more secure way for people to present their identity card.

Adding Your Identity Card

Adding Your State Identity Card Through Wallet
To add an identity card, you will be asked to take a picture of the front and back of your government ID card, such as your driving licence or state ID. Your device will evaluate the quality and type of the images to help ensure that the images you provide will be accepted by your government issuing authority. Your identity card images are encrypted on device and sent to your government issuing authority, which may share them with their third-party identity verification service provider; Apple does not see or store images of your identity card. Your device will read the barcode from your identity card and share your name, address and date of birth with Apple for identity verification and fraud prevention. Apple may continue to store information about the verification outcome, such as whether the identity information was successfully verified, to help support the feature and prevent fraud on underlying Apple platforms, but will not store the underlying identity information (such as the date of birth read from your barcode).

To help ensure that the person adding the identity card to Wallet is the same person to whom the identity card belongs, you will be asked to take a Live Photo of yourself. Your device will evaluate the quality of a still frame from the Live Photo you are providing in order to help ensure that the still frame photo you provide will be accepted by your government issuing authority. This still frame from your Live Photo will be encrypted on device and sent to your government issuing authority to be compared against their image on file for the ID. Your government issuing authority will process this still frame photo in accordance with their privacy policies, which may allow them to use facial recognition technology. To help prevent fraud, before your still frame photo is submitted to your government issuing authority, your Live Photo will be evaluated by your device and Apple to help ensure that the Live Photo is of a live person, and that the same live person is submitting their still frame photo as a part of adding their identity card to Wallet. You may be prompted to also conduct a series of facial and head movements, which will be evaluated in the same way as your Live Photo by your device and Apple. Information about your Live Photo, or if applicable, your movements, and not the Live Photo or recording of movements themselves, is stored in a way that is associated with you while you are in the process of adding your ID.

Information about your Apple Account, device use patterns and settings, device location at the time you attempt to add your state identity card (if you have Location Services enabled), and information about your Live Photo or facial and head movements, will be shared with Apple for fraud prevention. Apple will share fraud indicators based on this information with your government issuing authority for fraud prevention. Your government issuing authority, and not Apple, will decide whether to authorise adding your identity card to Wallet. In some cases, your government issuing authority may ask for more information or an in-person visit. Apple may receive information about the fact that your government issuing authority required additional verification and the type of verification (such as an in-person visit); Apple retains this information in a manner that is linked to you only while the government issuing authority is in the process of making a decision on whether to authorise adding your ID to Wallet for managing and improving the feature. In some cases, your government issuing authority may provide you with a verification code following their review of additional information. This verification code is encrypted on device and sent to the government issuing authority; Apple does not see or store the verification code. Your government issuing authority may provide Apple with information on the status of its authorisation (for example, under review or accepted) so that Apple may send updates to your device and help manage your identity card in Wallet.

Adding Your Digital ID Card Through Wallet
This feature is available only in the United States.

To add your Digital ID, you will be asked to scan the machine-readable zone (MRZ) text on your passport’s photo page using your iPhone in order to allow your device to access the e-passport chip within your passport. You will then need to place your iPhone on your passport, as instructed by your device, to read the e-passport. Your device will send the MRZ and e-passport data to Apple to validate the information contained in the e-passport. Apple will encode and store a portion of your passport information to provide and help manage your Digital ID on your device, as well as to prevent fraud. To help ensure the person adding the Digital ID Card to Wallet is the same person to whom the passport belongs, you will be required to take a Live Photo of yourself; the same as described above for state identity cards. For Digital ID, this information will be sent only to Apple as the issuing authority for Digital IDs, and not to your state or national government. Apple will collect and use information about your Live Photo, your Apple Account, device use patterns and settings, and device location at the time you attempt to add your Digital ID Card (if you have Location Services enabled), to determine whether to issue your Digital ID, and for fraud prevention purposes. Information about your Live Photo, and not the Live Photo itself, is stored in a way associated with you while you are in the process of adding your ID. If you choose to allow Apple to manually review your Live Photo, the Live Photo may be stored for a short period of time by Apple, as described in the Improving Identity Cards section below.

Adding Your Identity Card Through the Issuing Authority’s App
This feature is available only in Japan.

To add an identity card to Wallet through a government issuing authority’s app, you will need to agree to the issuing authority’s terms and conditions, and may need to complete steps to prove your identity to the government issuing authority, as well as setting up a PIN or password for your identity card. Your PIN or password can be updated only through the government issuing authority’s app. Apple does not receive any information about your activity in the government issuing authority’s app. Your government issuing authority, and not Apple, will decide whether to authorise adding your identity card to Wallet.

Provisioning Your Identity Card onto Your Device

Once the digital identity card issuing authority authorises adding your identity card to Wallet, the information reflected on your identity card is stored in an encrypted format that can be decrypted only using the Secure Enclave on your device. You can view this information at any time by going to Wallet, viewing the back of your identity card, tapping Driving Licence Info, State ID Info, Digital ID Info or Card Info, and authenticating to view details. Apple cannot see this information. To learn more about the Secure Enclave, visit support.apple.com/guide/security/secure-enclave-sec59b0b31ff/web.

Protecting Your ID in Wallet

To help protect your ID card from unauthorised access or presentment, you will be asked to tie your ID card to a Face ID appearance or a biometric identifier used for Touch ID. Presenting your ID or information from your ID will require authentication with the specific method and biometric identifier you tied to your ID during setup. Alternative authentication options may be available depending on your device settings. Your device, and not Apple, stores your authentication method. If you would like to change your authentication, you must delete your identity card and add it again to Wallet with the new authentication.

Presenting Your Identity Card

To present your identity card in person, hold your iPhone or Apple Watch near the identity reader to receive a consent sheet with information about who is requesting your identity and the specific information from your identity card being requested. Upon authorisation, your device will establish a direct, end-to-end encrypted channel with the identity reader and transmit the authorised information.

When presenting your Digital ID at participating Transportation Security Administration (TSA) checkpoints, your Digital ID will provide an indicator that it is an acceptable alternative to REAL ID. Your Digital ID is not a REAL ID document. Other third-party identity readers may also be able to request and receive this indicator. If a third-party identity reader collects this indicator when you present your Digital ID, it will appear on the consent sheet and in your presentment history. Because your Digital ID is created from your passport, when you present your Digital ID, the requesting party may be able to infer that you are a US citizen.

For Japanese identity cards only, you will need to pre-arm your identity card by selecting it in Wallet prior to tapping it on an identity reader to present. When presenting your identity card using Japanese Public Key Infrastructure, Wallet will not display information about the specific information being requested.

Apps requiring proof of age or identity to access their goods or services will present you with a consent sheet showing the specific information being requested, and how long that information will be stored by the requesting app. Upon authorisation, your device will transmit an encrypted payload containing the authorised information to the app. The encrypted payload includes a digital signature from the digital identity card issuing authority unique to your identity card to allow the app to verify that your identity card is valid.

You can view past presentments, including when, where and to whom you presented your identity card and the specific information presented, by tapping your identity card in Wallet. This information is generated by your device; neither Apple nor the digital identity card issuing authority know or keep a record of when, where or to whom you present your identity card. In Japan, the Government of Japan may learn information about your presentment as required to provide requested services, such as when presenting your identity card at hospitals.

Managing Your Identity Card

You can manage your identity card at any time by tapping your identity card in Wallet. To help protect your privacy and keep your identity card information secure, you will be asked to authenticate before you can view your identity details. To update or change your identity card information, you must contact your government issuing authority. To help manage your identity card in Wallet, your government issuing authority will periodically tell Apple whether your identity card is still valid. Apple will also receive information about any identity card updates from your government issuing authority, such as whether your address was updated or your identity card status was changed (for example, from active to inactive). Apple will not receive details about the update, such as your actual updated address. Apple will retain information about your identity card updates, such as whether your identity card status changed, while you keep an identity card in Wallet; this information will be used only for fraud prevention and security purposes.

Digital IDs do not receive updates when your passport is reissued. To update your Digital ID, you will need to delete your Digital ID and add a new Digital ID using your new passport.

You can delete your identity card from Wallet at any time by going to the back of your identity card in Wallet and tapping Remove Driving Licence, Remove State ID, Remove Digital ID or Remove Card. Removing your identity card will delete all presentment history from your device.

Improving Identity Cards

If you have opted in to provide Apple with this information, Apple will anonymously collect your age, sex, race/ethnicity (if available) and apparent skin tone from your driving licence or state ID, along with the government issuing authority’s decision about whether to issue you an identity card for Wallet. Apple will use this information to monitor for bias in the identity verification process. You can review this information or change your consent on your iOS device by going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements. When you provision through the government issuing authority’s app, you cannot opt in to Improving Identity Cards.

When adding your Digital ID or state identity card to Wallet, Apple may ask you to allow a small team of human reviewers within Apple to look at your Live Photo to help improve the IDs in Wallet experience. If you allow Apple to review your Live Photo, Apple will review and delete your Live Photo within 30 days.

Apple will not use any other information displayed on your identity card itself, such as your name or date of birth, to improve IDs in Wallet. Identity card data that is not linked to you may be retained to improve the feature and other Apple products and services. For example, Apple may retain anonymous and aggregate information about where users have difficulty when adding an identity card to Wallet in order to help improve the experience. Apple may also anonymise information it collects from you or receives from your government issuing authority in connection with this feature in order to improve identity cards in Wallet. For example, Apple will receive information about the quality of images submitted when adding your ID card to Wallet and whether the images were accepted by the government issuing authority. Apple may, for example, anonymise and use this information to help improve your device’s evaluation of the images to be submitted or to help provide users with better instructions on how to take images acceptable to the state issuing authorities.

Other

Apple may share information with our service providers, who are obligated to handle the information consistent with this notice and Apple instructions, are required to use reasonable security measures to protect any personal data received, and must delete the personal data as soon as they have completed the services unless retention is required by law or otherwise with your consent.

Apple retains personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including as described in this notice and in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, or as required by law. When assessing retention periods, we first carefully examine whether it is necessary to retain the personal data collected and, if retention is required, work to retain the personal data for the shortest period permissible by law.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/in/privacy.

ウォレットにIDを追加すると、身分証明書を簡単に、素早く、より安全に提示することができます。

身分証明書の追加

ウォレットからの州発行の身分証明書の追加
身分証明書を追加するには、政府機関の発行した身分証明書（運転免許証や州発行の身分証明書など）の表と裏の写真を撮るよう求められます。提出した画像が政府の発行機関に確実に承認されるよう、画像の品質と種類がデバイスによって評価されます。あなたの身分証明書の画像はデバイス上で暗号化され、政府の発行機関に送信されます。発行機関は第三者の本人確認サービス提供者と画像を共有する場合がありますが、Appleではあなたの身分証明書カードの画像を閲覧したり、保存したりすることはありません。デバイスであなたの身分証明書カードのバーコードを読み取り、本人確認と不正行為防止の目的で、名前、住所と生年月日がAppleと共有されます。Appleは、機能への対応を促進し、基となっているAppleのプラットフォーム上での不正行為を防止する目的で、身分証明書の情報が問題なく確認されたかどうかなどの確認結果に関する情報は保存し続けますが、バーコードから読み取った生年月日などの基本的な身分証明情報を保存することはありません。

ウォレットに身分証明書カードを追加しようとしている人がそのカードの所有者と同一人物であることを確認するため、自分で自分のLive Photosを撮影するよう求められます。提出した静止画像が政府の発行機関に確実に承認されるよう、Live Photosの静止画像の品質がデバイスによって評価されます。身分証明書用に登録されている画像と照合するために、このLive Photosの静止画像はデバイス上で暗号化されて政府の発行機関に送信されます。政府の発行機関は、機関のプライバシーポリシーに準拠してこの静止画像を処理し、その際に顔認証技術の使用が許可される場合があります。不正行為を防止するため、静止画像を政府の発行機関に提出する前に、あなたのLive PhotosはデバイスとAppleにより評価され、Live Photosが生身の人間のものであること、またその人物が身分証明書をウォレットに追加するために静止画像を提出している人と同一であることを確認することに役立てられます。また、一連の顔や頭の動きを行うことが求められることもあります。これらの動きは、デバイスとAppleによってLive Pohotosが評価されるのと同じ方法で評価されます。Live Photosや動き（求められた場合）に関する情報は保存されますが、Live Photosや動き自体の記録は保存されません。この情報は、身分証明書の追加を処理する際にあなたに関連付けられた形で保存されます。

あなたのApple Account、デバイスの使用パターンと設定に関する情報、州発行の身分証明書を追加しようとしたときのデバイスの位置情報（位置情報サービスを有効にしている場合）、ならびにあなたのLive Photosおよび顔と頭の動きに関する情報は、不正行為防止の目的でAppleと共有されます。Appleは、不正行為防止を目的として、この情報に基づいた不正行為の指標を政府の発行機関と共有します。身分証明書のウォレットへの追加を承認決定するのは、Appleではなく政府の発行機関です。場合によっては、政府の発行機関からさらなる情報や発行機関への直接来訪を求められることがあります。Appleは、政府の発行機関が追加の確認情報を求めた事実や確認を行う方法（例えば、直接来訪など）についての情報を受け取る場合があります。Appleは、政府の発行機関があなたの身分証明書をウォレットに追加することの承認決定を行なっている期間に限り、この機能の管理と改善を目的として、この情報をあなたに関連付けた形で保持します。場合によっては、政府の発行機関から追加の情報の審査に伴い、確認コードが提供されることもあります。この確認コードはデバイス上で暗号化され、政府の発行機関に送信されます。Appleでは確認コードを閲覧したり、保存したりすることはありません。政府の発行機関は、Appleがデバイスに承認状況のアップデートを送信し、身分証明書をウォレットで管理できるように、承認状況（例えば、審査中、承認済みなど）に関する情報をAppleに提供する場合があります。

ウォレットからのデジタルIDカードの追加
この機能は米国でのみ使用できます。

デジタルIDを追加する際には、デバイスがパスポート内の電子パスポートチップにアクセスできるようにするために、パスポートの写真のページにある機械読み取り領域（MRZ）のテキストをiPhoneでスキャンするよう求められます。その後、デバイスの指示に従ってiPhoneをパスポートにかざして、電子パスポートを読み取る必要があります。電子パスポートに含まれる情報を検証するために、MRZと電子パスポートのデータがデバイスからAppleに送信されます。Appleは、あなたのデバイス上でデジタルIDを提供および管理し、不正行為を防止するために、パスポート情報の一部をエンコードして保存します。ウォレットにデジタルIDカードを追加しようとしている人がパスポートの所有者と同一人物であることを確認するため、上記の州発行の身分証明書の場合と同じように、自分で自分のLive Photosを撮影するよう求められます。デジタルIDの場合、この情報はデジタルIDの発行機関であるAppleにのみ送信され、州または国の行政機関には送信されません。Appleは、デジタルIDを発行するかどうかの判断、および不正行為防止の目的で、Live Photos、あなたのApple Account、デバイスの使用パターンと設定、およびデジタルIDカードを追加しようとしたときのデバイスの位置情報（位置情報サービスを有効にしている場合）に関する情報を収集および使用します。Live Photosに関する情報は保存されますが、Live Photos自体は保存されません。この情報は、IDの追加を処理する際にあなたに関連付けられた形で保存されます。AppleにLive Photosの手動確認を許可することを選択すると、下記の“身分証明書カードの改善”のセクションに記載されているように、Live PhotosがAppleによって短期間保存される場合があります。

発行機関のアプリからの身分証明書の追加
この機能は日本でのみ使用できます。

政府の発行機関のアプリを使用してウォレットに身分証明書を追加するには、発行機関の利用規約に同意する必要があります。また、政府の発行機関に対して身元を証明するための手順を完了すること、および身分証明書のPINまたはパスワードを設定することが必要な場合があります。PINまたはパスワードは、政府の発行機関のアプリからのみアップデートできます。Appleは、政府の発行機関のアプリで行ったあなたの操作に関する情報を一切受け取りません。身分証明書のウォレットへの追加を承認決定するのは、Appleではなく政府の発行機関です。

デバイスへの身分証明書の情報提供

デジタル身分証明書の発行機関によってウォレットへの身分証明書の追加が承認されると、身分証明書を反映した情報は暗号化されて保存されます。暗号化された情報はデバイス上のSecure Enclaveを使用しない限り復号化できません。ウォレットに移動し、身分証明書の裏面を表示して、“運転免許情報”、“州発行のID情報”、“デジタルID情報”、または“カード情報”をタップして詳細の表示を認証することで、いつでもこの情報を表示することができます。Appleはこの情報を見ることはできません。Secure Enclaveに関して詳しくは、support.apple.com/guide/security/secure-enclave-sec59b0b31ff/web をご覧ください。

ウォレットでのIDの保護

不正に身分証明書カードがアクセスされたり提示されたりすることを防止するため、カードとFace IDの顔認証またはTouch IDで使用されている生体認証識別子を関連付けることが求められます。身分証明書またはその情報を提示するには、設定時に身分証明書と関連付けた特定の方法と生体認証識別子による認証が必要になります。デバイスの設定によっては、別の認証オプションが使用可能な場合もあります。認証方法は、Appleではなく、お使いのデバイスに保存されます。認証方法を変更したい場合、身分証明書カードを削除して、新規の認証方法と共に再びカードをウォレットに追加する必要があります。

身分証明書の提示

身分証明書を直接提示する場合は、iPhoneまたはApple Watchをリーダーにかざすと、誰があなたのIDを要求しているかに関する情報と、要求されているIDカードからの特定の情報が含まれた同意シートを受け取ることができます。認証時に、デバイスは、リーダーと直接のエンドツーエンドの暗号化チャンネルを確立して、認証された情報を送信します。

対応している運輸保安庁（TSA）の検問所でデジタルIDを提示すると、そのデジタルIDが実物のIDの代替として受け入れ可能であることを示すインジケータが表示されます。デジタルIDは実物の身分証明書ではありません。ほかの他社製の身分証明書リーダーでも、このインジケータを要求および受信できる場合があります。あなたがデジタルIDを提示したときに他社製の身分証明書リーダーでこのインジケータが収集される場合は、その旨が同意シートと提示履歴に表示されます。デジタルIDはパスポートから作成されるため、デジタルIDを提示すると、あなたが米国市民であることを要求元が推測できる可能性があります。

日本の身分証明書の場合のみ、身分証明書を身分証明書リーダーにタッチして提示する前に、ウォレットで身分証明書を選択して事前に表示しておく必要があります。日本の公的個人認証サービス（JPKI）を使用して身分証明書を提示する場合、要求されている特定の情報に関する情報はウォレットに表示されません。

商品またはサービスにアクセスするために年齢を証明できるものや身分証明書が必要なアプリでは、必要となる特定の情報が示された同意シートと、その情報が要求元のアプリで保存される期間が提示されます。認証時に、デバイスで、認証された情報が含まれる暗号化されたペイロードがアプリに送信されます。暗号化されたペイロードにはデジタル身分証明書の発行機関から発行された、あなたの身分証明書固有のデジタル署名が含まれます。これにより、アプリで、あなたの身分証明書が有効であることを確認できます。

ウォレットで身分証明書カードをタップすると、カードをいつどこで誰に提示したかや提示した情報についてなどの過去の提示履歴を表示できます。この情報はデバイスによって生成されたもので、Appleまたはデジタル身分証明書の発行機関が、いつどこで誰にあなたが身分証明書カードを提示したのかを知ることやその記録を保存することはできません。日本では、病院で身分証明書を提示した場合など、要求されたサービスを提供するために必要な場合、日本政府があなたの提示に関する情報を知ることがあります。

身分証明書の管理

ウォレットで身分証明書をタップすることで、いつでも身分証明書カードを管理できます。プライバシーを保護し、身分証明書カードの情報を安全に保管するために、身分証明カードの詳細を表示する前に認証が必要になります。身分証明書カードの情報をアップデートまたは変更するには、政府の発行機関に連絡する必要があります。ウォレットでの身分証明書カードの管理に役立てるために、Appleは、あなたの身分証明書カードがまだ有効であるかどうかの報告を政府の発行機関から定期的に受けます。また、Appleは、あなたの住所が更新されたかどうか、またはあなたの身分証明書カードの状況が変更されたかどうか（例えば、使用中から停止に変更）などの身分証明書カードの更新に関する情報を政府の発行機関から受け取ります。Appleが更新された具体的な住所などの更新に関する詳細を受け取ることはありません。Appleは、ウォレットに身分証明書カードが保存されているときに身分証明書カードの状況が変更されたかどうかなどの身分証明書カードの更新に関する情報を保持します。この情報は、不正行為防止とセキュリティの目的のみに使用されます。

デジタルIDは、パスポートが再発行されてもアップデートされません。デジタルIDをアップデートするには、デジタルIDを削除し、新しいパスポートを使用して新しいデジタルIDを追加する必要があります。

身分証明書カードの裏面を表示して、“運転免許証を削除”、“州発行のIDを削除”、“デジタルIDを削除”、または“カードを削除”をタップすることで、いつでも身分証明書カードをウォレットから削除できます。身分証明書カードを削除すると、すべての提示履歴がデバイスから削除されます。

身分証明書カードの改善

この情報をAppleに提供することを選択した場合、Appleは、ウォレットの身分証明書カードを発行するかどうかの政府の発行機関の決定と共に、あなたの年齢、性別、人種/民族（利用可能な場合）、および外見のスキントーンを運転免許証または州発行の身分証明書から匿名で収集します。Appleは、本人確認プロセスでの傾向を監視するためにこの情報を使用します。iOSデバイスで“設定”＞“プライバシーとセキュリティ”＞“解析と改善”に移動して、この情報を確認したり、同意を変更したりできます。政府の発行機関のアプリから情報を提供する場合、“身分証明書カードの改善”を選択することはできません。

デジタルIDまたは州発行の身分証明書をウォレットに追加する際に、ウォレットでのIDの体験の向上を目的として、Apple社内の少人数のレビュー担当チームがあなたのLive Photosを確認することを許可するようお願いする場合があります。AppleにLive Photosの確認を許可した場合、Appleは30日以内にLive Photosを確認して削除します。

Appleは、ウォレットのIDの機能を改善するために、身分証明書カードに表示される情報（名前や生年月日など）以外の情報を使用することはありません。あなたと関連付けられていない身分証明書カードのデータは、この機能およびその他のApple製品とサービスの改善のために保持される場合があります。例えば、Appleは、ユーザエクスペリエンス改善の目的で、ユーザが身分証明書カードをウォレットに追加するときにどこで問題に直面したかについての集約された匿名情報を保持する場合があります。また、Appleは、ウォレットの身分証明書カードを改善するために、この機能に関連してあなたから収集する情報または政府の発行機関から受け取る情報を匿名化します。例えば、Appleは、ウォレットに身分証明書カードを追加するときに提出された画像の品質に関する情報や、画像が政府の発行機関によって承認されたかどうかについての情報を受け取ります。Appleは、あなたのデバイスでの提出画像の評価を改善したり、州の発行機関に画像を承認してもらう方法についてのよりよい指示をユーザに提供したりする目的で、例えば、この情報を匿名化して使用するような場合もあります。

その他

Appleは、情報をAppleのサービス提供者と共有する場合があります。このサービス提供者は、この通知とAppleの指示に従って情報を処理する義務があり、受け取った個人データを保護するために合理的なセキュリティ対策を講じることが義務付けられています。また、個人情報は、保持することが法律により義務付けられている場合、あるいはあなたから同意を得ている場合を除き、サービス完了後、直ちに削除するものとしています。

Appleは、この通知に記載されている通りに、かつAppleのプライバシーポリシーに従って、または法律で定められた通りに、収集目的を達成するために必要な期間のみ個人データを保持します。保持期間の決定においては、まず収集した個人データを保持する必要があるかどうかを検討し、保持する必要がある場合は、法律の下で許容される最短の期間を個人データの保持期間とするように努めます。

いかなる場合においても、Appleが収集する情報はAppleのプライバシーポリシー（https://www.apple.com/jp/privacy を参照）に従って取り扱われます。

IDs in Wallet provide an easy, fast, and more secure way for people to present their identity card.

Adding Your Identity Card

Adding Your State Identity Card Through Wallet
To add an identity card, you will be asked to take a picture of the front and back of your government ID card, such as your driver’s license or state ID. Your device will evaluate the quality and type of the images to help ensure that the images you provide will be accepted by your government issuing authority. Your identity card images are encrypted on device and sent to your government issuing authority, which may share them with their third-party identity verification service provider; Apple does not see or store images of your identity card. Your device will read the barcode from your identity card and share name, address, and date of birth with Apple for identity verification and fraud prevention. Apple may continue to store information about the verification outcome, such as whether the identity information was successfully verified, to help support the feature and prevent fraud on underlying Apple platforms, but will not store the underlying identity information (such as the date of birth read from your barcode).

To help ensure that the person adding the identity card to Wallet is the same person to whom the identity card belongs, you will be asked to take a Live Photo of yourself. Your device will evaluate the quality of a still frame from the Live Photo you are providing in order to help ensure that the still frame photo you provide will be accepted by your government issuing authority. This still frame from your Live Photo will be encrypted on device and sent to your government issuing authority to be compared against their image on file for the ID. Your government issuing authority will process this still frame photo in accordance with their privacy policies, which may allow them to use facial recognition technology. To help prevent fraud, before your still frame photo is submitted to your government issuing authority, your Live Photo will be evaluated by your device and Apple to help ensure that the Live Photo is of a live person, and that the same live person is submitting their still frame photo as a part of adding their identity card to Wallet. You may be prompted to also conduct a series of facial and head movements, which will be evaluated in the same way as your Live Photo by your device and Apple. Information about your Live Photo, or if applicable your movements, and not the Live Photo or recording of movements themselves, is stored in a way that is associated with you while you are in the process of adding your ID.

Information about your Apple Account, device use patterns and settings, device location at the time you attempt to add your state identity card (if you have Location Services enabled), and information about your Live Photo, or facial and head movements, will be shared with Apple for fraud prevention. Apple will share fraud indicators based on this information with your government issuing authority for fraud prevention. Your government issuing authority, and not Apple, will decide whether to authorize adding your identity card to Wallet. In some cases, your government issuing authority may ask for more information or an in-person visit. Apple may receive information about the fact that your government issuing authority required additional verification and the type of verification (such as an in-person visit); Apple retains this information in a manner that is linked to you only while the government issuing authority is in the process of making a decision on whether to authorize adding your ID to Wallet for managing and improving the feature. In some cases, your government issuing authority may provide you with a verification code following their review of additional information. This verification code is encrypted on device and sent to the government issuing authority; Apple does not see or store the verification code. Your government issuing authority may provide Apple with information on the status of its authorization (for example, under review, accepted) so that Apple may send updates to your device and help manage your identity card in Wallet.

Adding Your Digital ID Card Through Wallet
This feature is available only in the United States.

To add your Digital ID, you will be asked to scan the machine-readable zone (MRZ) text on your passport’s photo page using your iPhone in order to allow your device to access the e-passport chip within your passport. You will then need to place your iPhone on your passport, as instructed by your device, to read the e-passport. Your device will send the MRZ and e-passport data to Apple to validate the information contained in the e-passport. Apple will encode and store a portion of your passport information to provide and help manage your Digital ID on your device, as well as to prevent fraud. To help ensure that the person adding the Digital ID Card to Wallet is the same person to whom the passport belongs, you will be required to take a Live Photo of yourself, the same as described above for state identity cards. For Digital ID, this information will be sent only to Apple as the issuing authority for Digital IDs, and not to your state or national government. Apple will collect and use information about your Live Photo, your Apple Account, device use patterns and settings, and device location at the time you attempt to add your Digital ID Card (if you have Location Services enabled), to determine whether to issue your Digital ID, and for fraud prevention purposes. Information about your Live Photo, and not the Live Photo itself, is stored in a way associated with you while you are in the process of adding your ID. If you choose to allow Apple to manually review your Live Photo, the Live Photo may be stored for a short period of time by Apple, as described in the Improving Identity Cards section below.

Adding Your Identity Card Through the Issuing Authority’s App
This feature is available only in Japan.

To add an identity card to Wallet through a government issuing authority’s app, you will need to agree to the issuing authority’s terms and conditions, and may need to complete steps to prove your identity to the government issuing authority, as well as setting up a PIN or password for your identity card. Your PIN or password can be updated only through the government issuing authority’s app. Apple does not receive any information about your activity in the government issuing authority’s app. Your government issuing authority, and not Apple, will decide whether to authorize adding your identity card to Wallet.

Provisioning Your Identity Card onto Your Device

Once the digital identity card issuing authority authorizes adding your identity card to Wallet, the information reflected on your identity card is stored in an encrypted format that can be decrypted only using the Secure Enclave on your device. You can view this information at any time by going to Wallet, viewing the back of your identity card, tapping “Driver’s License Info”, “State ID Info”, “Digital ID Info”, or “Card Info” and authenticating to view details. Apple cannot see this information. To learn more about the Secure Enclave, visit support.apple.com/guide/security/secure-enclave-sec59b0b31ff/web.

Protecting Your ID in Wallet

To help protect your ID card from unauthorized access or presentment, you will be asked to tie your ID card to a Face ID appearance or a biometric identifier used for Touch ID. Presenting your ID or information from your ID will require authentication with the specific method and biometric identifier you tied to your ID during set up. Alternative authentication options may be available depending on your device settings. Your device, and not Apple, stores your authentication method. If you would like to change your authentication, you must delete your identity card and add it again to Wallet with the new authentication.

Presenting Your Identity Card

To present your identity card in person, hold your iPhone or Apple Watch near the identity reader to receive a consent sheet with information about who is requesting your identity and the specific information from your identity card being requested. Upon authorization, your device will establish a direct, end-to-end encrypted channel with the identity reader and transmit the authorized information.

When presenting your Digital ID at participating Transportation Security Administration (TSA) checkpoints, your Digital ID will provide an indicator that it is an acceptable alternative to REAL ID. Your Digital ID is not a REAL ID document. Other third-party identity readers may also be able to request and receive this indicator. If a third-party identity reader collects this indicator when you present your Digital ID, it will appear on the consent sheet and in your presentment history. Because your Digital ID is created from your passport, when you present your Digital ID, the requesting party may be able to infer that you are a U.S. citizen.

For Japanese identity cards only, you will need to pre-arm your identity card by selecting it in Wallet prior to tapping it on an identity reader to present. When presenting your identity card using Japanese Public Key Infrastructure, Wallet will not display information about the specific information being requested.

Apps requiring proof of age or identity to access their goods or services will present you with a consent sheet showing the specific information being requested, and how long that information will be stored by the requesting app. Upon authorization, your device will transmit an encrypted payload containing the authorized information to the app. The encrypted payload includes a digital signature from the digital identity card issuing authority unique to your identity card to allow the app to verify that your identity card is valid.

You can view past presentments, including when, where, and to whom you presented your identity card, and the specific information presented, by tapping on your identity card in Wallet. This information is generated by your device; neither Apple nor the digital identity card issuing authority know or keep a record of when, where, or to whom you present your identity card. In Japan, the Government of Japan may learn information about your presentment as required to provide requested services, such as when presenting your identity card at hospitals.

Managing Your Identity Card

You can manage your identity card at any time by tapping on your identity card in Wallet. To help protect your privacy and keep your identity card information secure, you will be asked to authenticate before you can view your identity details. To update or change your identity card information, you must contact your government issuing authority. To help manage your identity card in Wallet, your government issuing authority will periodically tell Apple whether your identity card is still valid. Apple will also receive information about any identity card updates from your government issuing authority, such as whether your address was updated or your identity card status was changed (for example, from active to inactive). Apple will not receive details about the update, such as your actual updated address. Apple will retain information about your identity card updates, such as whether your identity card status changed, while you keep an identity card in Wallet; this information will be used only for fraud prevention and security purposes.

Digital IDs do not receive updates when your passport is reissued. To update your Digital ID, you will need to delete your Digital ID and add a new Digital ID using your new passport.

You can delete your identity card from Wallet at any time by going to the back of your identity card in Wallet and tapping “Remove Driver’s License”, “Remove State ID”, “Remove Digital ID”, or “Remove Card”. Removing your identity card will delete all presentment history from your device.

Improving Identity Cards

If you have opted in to provide Apple with this information, Apple will anonymously collect your age, sex, race / ethnicity (if available), and apparent skin tone from your driver’s license or state ID, along with the government issuing authority’s decision about whether to issue you an identity card for Wallet. Apple will use this information to monitor for bias in the identity verification process. You can review this information or change your consent on your iOS device by going to Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements. When you provision through the government issuing authority’s app, you cannot opt in to Improving Identity Cards.

When adding your Digital ID or state identity card to Wallet, Apple may ask you to allow a small team of human reviewers within Apple to look at your Live Photo to help improve the IDs in Wallet experience. If you allow Apple to review your Live Photo, Apple will review and delete your Live Photo within 30 days.

Apple will not use any other information displayed on your identity card itself, such as your name or date of birth, to improve IDs in Wallet. Identity card data that is not linked to you may be retained to improve the feature and other Apple products and services. For example, Apple may retain anonymous and aggregate information about where users have difficulty when adding an identity card to Wallet in order to help improve the experience. Apple may also anonymize information it collects from you or receives from your government issuing authority in connection with this feature in order to improve identity cards in Wallet. For example, Apple will receive information about the quality of images submitted when adding your ID card to Wallet and whether the images were accepted by the government issuing authority. Apple may, for example, anonymize and use this information to help improve your device’s evaluation of the images to be submitted or to help provide users with better instructions on how to take images acceptable to the state issuing authorities.

Other

Apple may share information with our service providers, who are obligated to handle the information consistent with this notice and Apple instructions, are required to use reasonable security measures to protect any personal data received, and must delete the personal data as soon as they have completed the services unless retention is required by law or otherwise with your consent.

Apple retains personal data only for so long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including as described in this notice and in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, or as required by law. When assessing retention periods, we first carefully examine whether it is necessary to retain the personal data collected and, if retention is required, work to retain the personal data for the shortest period permissible under law.

At all times, information collected by Apple will be treated in accordance with Apple’s Privacy Policy, which can be found at www.apple.com/privacy.
